text: Reduce the context residual capacity from 32 hidden units to 8 hidden units.
rationale: The residual gain over experiment 1 was only 0.000233 primary, and the experiment 3 regularization change slightly regressed. A smaller residual directly tests whether the useful context effect is low-dimensional and whether excess capacity harms generalization.
exact_ablation: Change only the nonlinear context residual hidden width from 32 ReLU units to 8; preserve its embeddings, output head, additive ID terms, BCE, optimizer, and all hyperparameters otherwise.

expected_effect.GAUC: Likely flat to +0.0006 as noisy residual degrees of freedom are removed; a loss of up to 0.0004 is possible if the parent uses genuinely complex context effects.
expected_effect.nDCG@5: Likely +0.0001 to +0.0008 from smoother ranking, though reduced capacity could make the effect flat.
